capabilities: Move pasted or dropped canvas images into a folder next to the canvas
Update canvas links after moving an image
Trash images after a delay once no canvas or note uses them
Limit sorting to chosen canvas folders and file extensions
Rename duplicates with a numbered suffix
disambiguation: Despite the generic name, it only handles images on canvas files and image embeds; it never moves notes, PDFs or other files.
extras: Warns that images referenced only via HTML, plugin data, or outside Obsidian count as unused and may be trashed; unused-image removal is off by default with a 30-second undo delay.
problem: Obsidian saves pasted canvas images in a single global attachment folder, and images removed from canvases stay in the vault as unused files.
summary: Canvas image manager that moves pasted or dropped images into a folder next to the canvas and trashes images no canvas or note uses anymore.
